## Satis Appraisal v0.2.2

### Pricing estimates
The Pricing step can now research real-world figures for a project and show a suggestion beside each covered field: the likely value, a low-high range, confidence, the reasoning, and dated sources. Nothing changes until you press Apply (per field, per group, or apply-all), and suggestions flag themselves as stale after 30 days.

- **Sales & rents**: sold prices within half a mile (up to 18 months old, indexed to today using recorded local UK House Price Index growth) reconciled with current asking prices; the uplift for newly converted flats is measured from evidence where it exists; thin evidence widens the search radius and says so. The same run fills the 5-year house price projection, so growth to completion is only ever counted once.
- **Build cost**: a researched all-in conversion cost per sqft (prelims and contractor overheads included; contingency and demolition stay separate), applied by scaling the room-rate table so your ratios are preserved.
- **Finance rates**: bridging, development, VAT loan and refinance pricing shaped to the deal's LTV, size and asset type; the deposit rate is pegged to SONIA minus a researched spread.
- Your own **tender results and lender term sheets** can be recorded in Settings (shared across projects) and anchor the estimates to what contractors and lenders actually quote you.

### Exact stamp duty
SDLT (cost line B04) now computes live from HMRC bands with a per-project selector: non-residential / mixed use (the default), residential company rates, or manual for the solicitor's figure. When the property is opted to tax, SDLT is charged on the VAT-inclusive price automatically. Projects saved before this release keep their typed figure until the selector is switched.

### Claude sign-in with nothing to install
If the Anthropic CLI is not on the machine, the app now downloads the pinned release itself the first time you sign in, verifying it against a published SHA-256 checksum before running anything. A CLI you installed yourself always takes precedence.

### Audit
The engine change went through the DCF audit-agent battery: independent recomputation of the SDLT band maths, the monthly cost stream, all conservation identities and seven stressed configurations. Findings (export/engine SDLT parity, duplicate SDLT lines, legacy file loading) were fixed with failing-first tests and recorded in AUDIT.md. 143 tests green; the LibreOffice workbook crosscheck agrees to the penny.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Satisgroup-1/Appraisalapplication/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2
